name: PunisherFinTheme
overview: Selectable, accent-aware designs for Jellyfin Web.
description: Offers complete PunisherFin and Cinema Deck designs for cards, episodes, details, previews, and players while preserving Jellyfin's native behavior.

versions.changelog: Extends the global accent color to Jellyfin search fields, search suggestions, focus and selection states, all five artwork-placeholder variants used by people and studios, legacy active control groups, and remaining playback/OSD progress elements. Missing actor and studio artwork now keeps Jellyfin's visual variants while deriving every background from the configured accent color.

Applies the configured global accent color to every home, library, continue-watching, and detail-card action, including Jellyfin 12 secondary more and favorite controls and their MUI variants. PunisherFin branding now also survives Jellyfin's late mobile and browser updates: the document title and favicon are continuously synchronized, nested mobile header labels are detected, and server identity entries in mobile drawers are no longer limited to desktop dashboard markup.
